app_store.name: Barline: Workout Log
app_store.subtitle: Unlimited routines and charts
app_store.promotional_text: Log sets, rest between them, watch the line go up. Unlimited routines and custom exercises, all-time charts, no account needed.
app_store.description:
Barline is a fast gym log.

Start a workout, add exercises, tick each set as you finish it. The rest timer starts on its own. Last session's numbers sit next to every set, so you always know what to beat.

What you get, free:
- Unlimited routines, with folders and supersets
- Unlimited custom exercises
- Warm-up, drop and failure sets, and RPE if you want it
- Personal records spotted when you save
- All-time charts for every exercise and your body weight
- Works with no signal and no account
- Export everything to CSV

Your log stays on your phone unless you choose to sync it.
